key_findings: Chainlink CCIP combines progressive reference disclosure with an explicit external-effect approval protocol and a real Promptfoo eval contract; the suite was inspected but not run.

Chainlink CRE uses fetch-as-resolution rather than speculative browsing, a useful pattern for freshness-sensitive developer Skills, but live source/host behavior remains external to the Skill contract.
Zephyr separates generated registry consistency and document quality gates from real build/hardware validation; its lightweight overlay helper must not be treated as a west-build substitute.
Dreamina has a real deterministic Python wrapper and dry-run/JSON contract, but this batch performed no service execution or behavioral eval.
Large Wondel and Cybersecurity inventories were not converted into synthetic body-level completions; exact-tree duplicates map to existing canonical content only.
Six April 8 agentskills hits were specification/reference-SDK copies and were reclassified instead of being promoted from metadata.
